r: About **36,000 km** (**35,786 km**) above the equator = orbit **radius ~42,000 km** (**42,164 km** from Earth's centre); period **24 hours (1 day)**
Revolves **in the same direction as the Earth rotates** (west to east) with the same period – appears fixed over one point
**Centripetal force**, supplied by the **Earth's gravitational pull on the satellite** (not a rocket engine, not the Sun)
**None needed** to keep orbiting – no drag in near-vacuum; solar panels only power the instruments
**Geostationary satellites** relay TV across the world (three cover nearly the whole globe); ground and space waves are short-range
Sending data **up to the satellite / network** = **uplink**; receiving from it = **downlink**
